data.long_meaning: Jetu is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, which means 'born from the ether'. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that Jatayu, a great sage, was born from the sky. This name signifies a connection to the divine and a strong spiritual foundation. The name Jetu carries the meaning “Born from the ether” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jetu usually hope their child will grow to embody born from the ether and live with faith, good character and purpose.
